michelle: Ok team — quick kickoff for the Search Tactical sprint. We need a short, actionable checklist for launch posts + webinar landing: keywords, schema, internal links, redirects. Can folks call dibs on owners? :raised_hands:
alex: I can own the keyword matrix and benchmarks. I pushed an initial sheet: https://docs.redwood.ai/kw-matrix (column: intent, seed kw, priority, traffic est). Focus: 3 pillar phrases per post + 1 long-tail CTA phrase.
sam: I’ll do the redirect map for any old URLs and gated-report link flows. Need to confirm the webinar CTA URL pattern — is it /webinar/{slug} ?
chris: Yup, pattern is /webinar/{slug}. For redirects, prefer netlify-style + server rules. Example snippet for nginx we use in infra:```rewrite ^/old-path/(.*)$ /new-path/$1 permanent;```Also flag: trailing-slash canonicalization — make sure canonical tags match the redirect destination.
seo-bot: crawl-alert: found 18 404s on /blog/2022/* and 3 pages with duplicate meta titles — see /ops/crawl/1761234500-report.json
kate: I’ll take internal linking and schema (FAQ + Event schema for webinar + Article schema for launch posts). Plan: add an internal-link template block to all posts: "Also in this series" + 3 recommended anchors (product, benchmark, webinar).
michelle: Great — owners: alex (keywords/benchmarks), sam (redirects + landing flow), kate (internal linking + schema), chris (infra rules/canonical). Timeline: brief by EOD Wed, final PRs by next Tue.
alex: Quick Q: for benchmark narratives, do we want to surface a short snip for meta description that ties to the primary KPI? e.g., "Benchmark: 30% lower latency at 1/3 the cost" — will add as a recommended meta copy column.
sam: For gated-report redirects, we need a fallback that preserves utm + session. Recommend redirect that appends querystring: nginx: `return 301 https://app.redwood.ai/new-report$request_uri;` — or use `proxy_pass` if we need session cookie.
chris: One more infra note: for private deployment docs we should 301 old docs to the new private path, not render 200 with canonical — quicker for SEO.
kate: On schema details: webinar Event schema needs `startDate`, `endDate`, `location` (set to "Online"), and `offers` (free). I'll draft JSON-LD snippet and add to the shared drive.
michelle: Perfect. Deliverables: 1) keyword sheet v1, 2) redirect map + nginx snippets, 3) schema JSON-LD examples, 4) internal link template + post patch PR. Put PR links in this thread when ready. :rocket:
alex: will do, assigning myself now.
sam: starting redirect audit now, will ping with a short list by tomorrow morning.
chris: I’ll open a tiny infra RFC for canonical rules (2–3 lines) and tag @eng-runtime for quick signoff.
kate: drafting schema + example for webinar landing, expect PR by Mon.
michelle: thanks all — tiny ask: add a one-line impact estimate to each PR (traffic delta or risk). keeps PMs happy. :memo:
